achievement.name: QS Reimagine Education 2026 Shortlisted
achievement.description: This project has achieved world-class recognition in educational innovation, being selected as one of the top applications from a pool of 2,226 submissions in the QS Reimagine Education Awards 2026. This shortlisted application demonstrated exceptional innovation, impact, and scalability, successfully progressing through four rigorous evaluation rounds conducted by a panel of 1634 international higher education and edtech experts.

criteria.narrative: Learning Design Excellence Award - Rigorous 4-round evaluation by 1,634 international experts.
